system.description: Dabbler Base 6.1 - Concealment Mastery. Spells to blend into shadow, turn objects invisible, disguise or perfectly duplicate an object's look and feel, locate a described object, create darkness, and displace the caster's apparent position to foil attacks, culminating in Concealment Mastery. Special Notes: When using the Locate Object spell, the caster must provide an unambiguous description of the object. This includes a minimum of: the item's dimensions (within 10% of actual size) and at least two other identifying attributes (e.g., color, weight, shape, texture, etc.). Often, it will take more than two other attributes to make the description "unique."

Target and objects on his person appear to be a shadow; and thus are almost invisible in dark areas (e.g., in many situations this could be handled with a special bonus between +25 and +75 to Stalking/Hiding maneuvers).

Up to three objects (e.g., 1 garment, 1 naked body, and 1 weapon) are made invisible. The object(s) will remain invisible until 24 hours pass, or the object is struck by a violent blow (being hit by a weapon, falling, etc.), or the object makes a violent move (i.e., an attack).

Target inanimate object takes on the visual appearance of a similar object. For example, a small red key may appear as a small blue spoon. The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given dimension. This is strictly a visual illusion (and can be detected as such), see Section 15.14 (p. 98).
Allows the caster to find any inanimate object. The caster must be able to uniquely describe the object.

Creates an area of darkness up to 2' radius per level about the point touched. The darkness is equal to the darkest night. If the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object or being. See Section 15.12 (p. 98).

Target inanimate object takes on the visual and tactile appearance of another object. For example, a crystal goblet might look and feel like a wooden mug. The object cannot vary in dimensions by more than 100% of actual size in any given dimension. This is an illusion (and can be detected as such), see Section 15.14 (p. 98).
As Unseen III, except affects up to five objects.
Target appears to be offset from where he actually is. All attacks have no effect 10% of the time. Each time a foe misses him, the chance of that foe missing again drops by 5%.
As Conceal I, except affects up to three objects.
As Unseen III, except affects up to ten objects.
As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 20%.
As Secret I, except affects up to three objects.
As Unseen III, except affects up to fifteen objects.
As Conceal I, except affects up to five objects.
As Unseen III, except affects up to twenty objects.
As Secret I, except affects up to five objects.
As Displacement I, except chance of missing is 30%.
As Conceal I, except affects up to ten objects.
As Unseen III, except affects up to one object for every level of the caster.
As Secret I, except affects up to ten objects.
As Conceal I, except affects a number of objects equal to the caster's level.
